status_detail: Administrative closeout completed under the authorized lifecycle and accepted Option A. The public immutable consumer-scoped sidecar requirements, owner-bound retained-result references and observations, closed resolution outcomes, and pure DevelopmentPrerequisiteResolver are implemented with focused software verification, complete Python conformance, synchronized public documentation, corrected independent review, and passing repository checks. Verified eligibility findings never convert prerequisite facts into operation authority.
